The Format-2 retrieval is FileRegistry.ReadKeyedShared, which owns it (the conflict check and the ceiling run before the physical step, so there is no post-read patch of a status the connector had already committed a position for); KeyedIoEmitter.EmitRead renders ONE call instead of a read plus an adjustment. (b) the '51' is stamped by ConflictOnLockedRecord; (c) the record area is left UNCHANGED (the documented refinement of 'undefined') because the emitters store only inside the success branch and the governed entries clear the out image; (e) the status begins '5', which no success branch takes. On the pre-fix tree the sequential leg already passed and the relative and indexed legs answered '00 BBBBB' / '00 CCCCC' - the record the READ was refused was silently skipped. OBSERVED, conformance:cases/14.9.30-READ/pb338_random_read_conflict_position - the Format-2 arm: an indexed DYNAMIC connector with the ALTERNATE key as key of reference is refused a random read on its PRIME key, and its next READ NEXT continues in ALTERNATE order (item d); pre-fix it answered '10' because the refused read had established the prime key of reference and moved the indicator to the last record. The relative leg pins item (a) against GR29's assignment: a random read of RRN 4 refused '51' leaves the indicator at 1, so the next sequential read delivers RRN 2, not RRN 5.
